text: i dont want to live anymore, i have decided
why: explicit ideation, phrase is in the lexicon

text: i keep thinking about killing myself and it wont stop
im going to end it tonight, ive already written the note
why: intent plus timeframe plus preparation - highest-risk pattern there is

text: i have a plan for this weekend and im not scared anymore
why: plan and timeframe without any lexicon phrase

text: ive been giving away my things, i wont need them where im going
why: giving away possessions is a documented pre-attempt behaviour

text: thank you all for the years. ive made my peace with everything
why: leave-taking. Reads as gratitude, which is why it gets missed

text: im tired of fighting. everyone would be better off without me here
i dont see the point of waking up again. im done trying
i just want to sleep and never wake up
why: the most common euphemism in help-seeking text

text: i wont be a problem for anyone much longer
theres nothing left to fix. im checking out
honestly i feel calm for the first time in months. the decision is made
why: sudden calm after prolonged distress is a recognised escalation, and reads positive

text: mujhe ab jeena nahi hai, bahut ho gaya
why: explicit Hinglish ideation, one word off the lexicon entry

text: sab khatam karna hai, ab himmat nahi bachi
ab main aur nahi kar sakta, sab kuch chhod dena chahta hoon hamesha ke liye
why: Hinglish euphemism, nothing in the lexicon

text: meri family ko mere bina zyada acha lagega, main bojh hoon
bhagwan mujhe utha le, ab aur nahi sehen hota
why: religious framing of a death wish - very common register in Indian users

text: main thak gaya hoon is zindagi se, ab bas hamesha ka rest chahiye
kal subah tak shayad main na rahoon, sabko sorry
maine sabko alvida keh diya hai, ab bas aakhri kaam baaki hai
i cant take it anymore, nothing i do matters
i feel completely hopeless, nothing is ever going to change
why: hopelessness is the strongest non-ideation predictor

text: im a burden to everyone around me and i know it
i feel completely trapped, there is no way out of any of this
whats even the point of any of it anymore
bahut ghutan ho rahi hai, kuch samajh nahi aa raha
why: Hinglish distress, 'ghutan' is in the lexicon

text: main kisi kaam ka nahi hoon, sabko sirf problem deta hoon
himmat toot rahi hai, har din bas struggle hai aur kuch nahi
i havent slept properly in weeks and im completely exhausted
im so anxious today i can barely function
i feel really alone lately and its getting heavy
aaj kal neend nahi aati aur bahut stress rehta hai
bahut akela feel kar raha hoon in dino
i attempted six years ago. im still here and mostly glad about that
why: recovery narrative. Must never be escalated - it is the post the platform exists to protect

text: i used to feel that way every single day. therapy helped more than i expected
back then i didnt want to be here. now i have reasons to stay
why: contains ideation language about the past, explicitly negated

text: 2 saal pehle maine attempt kiya tha lekin ab main bahut behtar hoon
pehle mujhe bhi lagta tha ki sab khatam kar doon, ab nahi lagta
why: contains a lexicon phrase inside an explicit negation

text: my friend has been talking about not wanting to be here and im worried
why: third-party concern - the author is not the person at risk

text: my sister said something scary last night, how do i help her
mere dost ko aisa lagta hai ki wo bojh hai, main usse kaise help karoon
you are worthless and everyone would be better off without you
why: directed at another person. A1 harassment, not a crisis signal about the author

text: nobody would even miss you if you disappeared tomorrow
why: abuse using crisis vocabulary. Routing this to the crisis queue sends support to the abuser

text: tumhare bina sabko acha lagega, tum bas bojh ho
that film was so depressing it made me want to die of boredom
this deadline is absolutely killing me
i could have died of embarrassment when it happened
movie itni boring thi ki mar jaane ka mann kar raha tha
why: Hinglish hyperbole using a death phrase

text: i called the helpline last night and it actually helped a lot
why: help already engaged. Some elevation is fine; a high-risk escalation is not

text: i have a safety plan and my therapist knows what to watch for
maine apne therapist se baat ki hai, ab thoda better lag raha hai
we covered suicide risk assessment in my psychology class today
why: clinical discussion of the topic, not a disclosure

text: that article on suicide prevention was really well written, sharing it here
why: resource sharing. Escalating this discourages people from circulating help

text: work has been busy but the weekend was genuinely good
aaj kal thoda stress hai office mein lekin manage ho raha hai
kal group session bahut acha tha, sabne apni baat share ki
why: positive Hinglish post - must not be escalated at all
